overall: The AG found the Fall River City Council violated the Open Meeting Law when a quorum deliberated at an unposted August 2, 2016 subcommittee meeting, consistent with OML 2016-117; no remedy was ordered, and the AG commended the Council's stated intent to comply, closing the complaint as resolved.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that a quorum of the Council deliberated at an August 2, 2016 subcommittee meeting for which no notice was posted.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated in OML 2016-117, this violated the Open Meeting Law.
